home.title: {{brand}}, the Gabonese public social network
home.lead: A network open to everyone and built on trust: every profile and every page carries a badge computed by the service, never self-declared.

networks.diaspora: The Gabonese diaspora, on its own network, whose members are also part of {{brand}}.
networks.administration: The pages of verified public administrations, mirrored from their own space, read-only.

home.status: The service will open in stages. This development version already lets you sign in, choose your handle, post and react.

session.failed: Your session could not be renewed.
session.backendMissing: The engine is not configured for this application.

me.title: Profile
me.lead: Your space: public profile, preferences, personal data and sign-out.
me.profileHint: What members see of you: posts, albums and connections.
me.storiesHint: Your stories and your network's, full screen.
me.feedPreferencesHint: Hidden posts and muted authors, to show again whenever you want.
me.settingsHint: Display, theme, background pattern, language and time zone.
me.personalDataHint: Export, erasure, decisions about you and notifications. Open even during a suspension.

signIn.title: Sign in to {{brand}}
signIn.lead: Receive a one-time code by email. No password.
signIn.codeLead: A six-digit code was sent to {{email}}. It expires in five minutes.
signIn.resent: A new code has been sent.
signIn.devCodeHint: Shown only in local development, instead of the email.

errors.expiredCode: This code has expired: ask for a new one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts: ask for a new code.
errors.deliveryUnavailable: Sending codes by email is not open yet on this deployment.

welcome.title: Welcome to {{brand}}
welcome.lead: Choose how members will see you. Nothing is published without you.
welcome.previewLead: Check your display name and handle before joining the network.
welcome.displayNameHint: The name members will see. It is not copied from any registry.
welcome.handleHint: Your address on the network: unaccented letters, digits, a dot, a hyphen or an underscore.
welcome.consentLabel: I agree that my social profile (display name and handle) is visible to network members.
welcome.consentRequired: Your agreement is required to join the network.
welcome.timeZoneHint: Detected on your device; you can change it before continuing.

feedPreferences.title: My feed
feedPreferences.lead: Find posts you have hidden and authors you have muted. You can undo these choices at any time.
feedPreferences.scope: These choices apply to your ANTSIA feed. Authors are not notified. Restoring a post does not unmute its author; unmuting an author does not restore posts hidden individually.
feedPreferences.availability: Only posts you can still access are shown here.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

notificationOpen.title: Open a notification
notificationOpen.unavailable: This notification is no longer available in your session. You can view your other notifications.
notificationOpen.error: The notification could not be checked. Try again or view your other notifications.

identity.title: Your identity
identity.lead: A verified IDN account strengthens trust in your profile.
identity.unavailable: IDN verification is not yet available.
identity.handoffFailed: The handoff did not complete. Try again.

personal.title: My data and appeals
personal.lead: Review decisions concerning you and stay in control of your data.
personal.exportLead: A personal file contains your information and content. Authentication and notification credentials are excluded.
personal.error: This operation did not complete. You can try again.
personal.eraseLead: Erasure of your social data is scheduled after a 30-day cancellation period. Retained quotations become anonymous. Commitments and transaction copies held by professionals follow a separate process.
personal.reportsLead: The reports you have submitted: acknowledgement, legal deadline and decision. The author does not know who you are.
personal.noReports: You have not submitted any report.
personal.appealHint: Explain your request in 10 to 500 characters.
personal.pushUnavailable: Notifications for this device have not been configured yet.
personal.pushEnabled: Notifications are enabled on this device.
personal.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings.
personal.weeklyLimitError: Choose a whole number between 0 and 100.
personal.commerceLead: Withdraw consent or retry its withdrawal even if the shop or network is no longer accessible. Pending means confirmation from PRO.GA is still missing.
personal.commerceEmpty: No commercial consents on this page.
personal.eraseBookings: Upcoming appointments with professionals: {{count}}. Erasing your account does not cancel them on their side; cancel them first from My requests.
personal.eraseBookingsMany: You have at least {{count}} upcoming appointments with professionals. Erasing your account does not cancel them on their side; cancel them first from My requests.
personal.pageDecisionsLead: Content carried by a page you represent (offer, job post, reply, event) can be removed by moderation. An active signatory of the page can appeal on its behalf.
personal.pageDecisionsUnavailable: This page’s decisions are not available right now.
personal.eraseCommerce: ANTSIA erasure does not cancel or refund appointments, orders or payments. It does not confirm erasure of copies held by PRO.GA or professionals. Retention of invoices, evidence and other transaction data follows a separate process whose rules remain to be validated.
personal.eraseBookingsUnknown: The number of upcoming appointments is unknown. An unavailable read does not mean there are none. Review your requests and commitments before deciding.
personal.eraseBookingsNone: No upcoming appointment was identified in the requests reviewed. This count does not cover your orders or payments.
personal.eraseBookingsEmptyWindow: No upcoming appointment was identified in the reviewed window. Other requests may not be covered.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Set how {{brand}} looks, its language and your time zone.
settings.displayLead: Your theme is saved to your account and follows you to your other devices. Appearance and background pattern stay specific to this device.

preferences.title: Your preferences
preferences.lead: Choose your language and the time zone used for dates and times across your networks.
preferences.localeHint: Your chosen language applies after saving.
preferences.timeZoneHint: Use a time zone name, such as Africa/Libreville or Europe/Paris. Daylight saving time is taken into account.
preferences.invalidTimeZone: Enter a valid time zone, such as Africa/Libreville.
preferences.appearanceHint: Appearance changes immediately. This choice is saved for this network on this device.

theme.label: Theme
theme.hint: Each theme has three colors, one for each family of actions: posting, following and writing, reacting and joining. Backgrounds stay light or dark according to your appearance setting. The change is immediate and saved to your account, so you find it on your other devices.
theme.hintDevice: Each theme has three colors, one for each family of actions: posting, following and writing, reacting and joining. Backgrounds stay light or dark according to your appearance setting. The change is immediate and saved for this network on this device.
theme.saveFailed: The theme could not be saved to your account. {{reason}}

gaboma.name: Gaboma
gaboma.description: Green, yellow and blue of the flag. The network’s theme.

sable.name: Sand
sable.description: Gabon blue, teal and golden sand. DIASPORALE’s theme.

motif.label: Background pattern
motif.hint: By default the background is plain. A pattern stays subtle behind the content and applies to this device only.

preferences.unsaved: Your changes have not been saved. Save your preferences before leaving this page.
preferences.leaveConfirm: Leave this page without saving your preferences?

publicAgent.title: Appear as a public agent
publicAgent.lead: With your permission and active administrative proof, the Public agent badge, your administration’s name and your public role may appear on your ANTSIA profile. Your chosen name and headline are not replaced. Your profile’s privacy and visibility settings continue to apply.
publicAgent.independent: This permission is optional. Withdrawing it removes the display of your public agent status; it does not unpublish your profile, delete your account or leave your other networks.
publicAgent.consentLabel: I allow ANTSIA to display my public agent status, administration and public role under the conditions above.
publicAgent.consentRequired: Select the checkbox to give your explicit permission.
publicAgent.loadFailed: Your permission could not be loaded. Try again before enabling it.
publicAgent.idnRequired: An admitted IDN identity already linked to your account is required to give this permission. Existing permission can still be withdrawn.
publicAgent.sourceUnavailable: The administrative source is not configured or available. New permission cannot be enabled right now. You can still withdraw existing permission.
publicAgent.versionChanged: The text has changed. Read the conditions again and select the checkbox again to give your permission.
publicAgent.granted: Your permission is recorded. Display also depends on active administrative proof and your profile’s visibility.
publicAgent.transferLead: To send this permission to your administration, prepare a temporary link and then open it. Preparing it does not leave this page.
publicAgent.openTransfer: Open the link to my administration
publicAgent.transferExpires: This temporary link expires on {{date}}. Open it to continue in your administration.
publicAgent.transferExpired: This link has expired. Prepare a new link to continue.
publicAgent.transferFailed: The link could not be prepared. Try again. You can still withdraw your permission.

statuses.inactive: You have no active permission for this display.
statuses.waiting: Your permission is recorded. Proof from your administration is pending; your public agent status is not displayed yet.
statuses.active: Your permission and active administrative proof are recorded. Display respects your profile’s visibility.
statuses.revoked: Your permission is withdrawn. Your public agent status is no longer displayed.
statuses.unavailable: Your public agent status cannot be displayed right now.

publicAgent.publicExplanation: This administrative status is displayed with the person’s permission and active administrative proof. It is separate from their chosen name and headline.

analytics.title: Optional usage measurement
analytics.lead: With your permission, ANTSIA may measure the categories of screens viewed, the network and language, associated with a temporary browser identifier. No message, content, social identifier, profile address or session recording is sent.
analytics.active: Your permission is recorded. Measurement is active on member screens.
analytics.inactive: Usage measurement is disabled in this browser.
analytics.unconfigured: The measurement service is not configured. You can still withdraw existing permission.
analytics.grantFailed: Your permission could not be recorded. Try again.
analytics.revokeFailed: Measurement has stopped in this browser, but your withdrawal could not be recorded. Try again before closing this page.
